items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Oh sure, I heard Buddy Bowling.

ctx.x: They all know you know too.

Sure, that's right. You were telling us about the bowling. You were a boy when you heard bowling. Can you remember anything about him? I didn't even know recording with Buddy Bowling. No, I know. I mean did you hear him play? Oh sure, I heard Buddy Bowling.
Used to go back to, had the economy hall there. Not the economy hall there, Mason's Hall right? On the David Street then? I used to go to Buddy Bowling. Buddy Bowling. Buddy Bowling.
